title: Lovett on booking agents
summary: Lovett says agents are all right and often necessary, though some he will not discuss.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: How -- you know all of us have dealt with band leaders, theater owners, club owners, record companies, music publishers, song publishers, promoters, bookers, booking agents and the union, of course. Did any of these contacts have an effect on you, good or bad? Can you remember any incidents where somebody really helped you in this category or perhaps where you felt you were put upon, hurt by anyone; a booking agent?
Yeah, what do you think of booking agents?
I think they're all right. A lot of times you wouldn't be working if you didn't have one. I'll tell
you that much, but some of them I have to say -- you understand what I mean.
Yeah, that's what I thought you were going to tell me.
Yeah, I wouldn't tell you, though.
